    Solves the J1-J2 frustrated Heisenberg chain on a 9-site chain with open boundary conditions,
    sweeping J2/J1 from 0.00 to 0.80 in steps of 0.05, and detects the onset of dimerization.
    Verifies the simulation at J2/J1 = 0.5 (Majumdar-Ghosh point) and at J2=0 (Heisenberg limit).
